capabilities.capability: Image and PDF primitive recognition, OCR, and calibration boundary
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Existing offline recognition tests plus the affected approved private real-data benchmark.
capabilities.migration: Keep primitive_ir_lib as the sole image/PDF recognition and OCR boundary.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the inventory entry; the existing recognition runtime remains unchanged.

capabilities.capability: Semantic parts, compound inference, constraint pruning, and solving
capabilities.adapter: Route multisource component evidence through the existing Semantic IR assembly and SolveSpace boundaries.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Existing semantic, pruning, solving, and affected real-data constraint tests.
capabilities.migration: Add only a source-bundle adapter at the existing semantic assembly boundary.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the adapter and inventory entry; semantic IR and solver APIs remain authoritative.

capabilities.capability: Audited ambiguity proposal and separately approved application
capabilities.adapter: Bind multisource ambiguity evidence to AgentReport proposals while preserving the existing hash-bound apply gate.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Agent advisory and explicit approval/application tests; ambiguous decisions remain human-gated.
capabilities.migration: Use AgentReport as the only proposal representation and keep application as a second approved invocation.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the adapter; existing advisory and approval behavior remains unchanged.

capabilities.capability: Native editable DXF and component/entity generation
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Existing native DXF builder and headless read-back tests.
capabilities.migration: Keep all new component output on the existing dxf_builder_lib builder boundary.
capabilities.rollback: Revert inventory-only references; no DXF builder code is changed by R0.

capabilities.capability: Headless DXF review and deterministic repair
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Existing headless review/repair tests before any AutoCAD mutation.
capabilities.migration: Route candidate DXF checks through review_dxf and approved repair APIs only.
capabilities.rollback: Revert inventory-only references; existing headless safety boundary remains unchanged.

capabilities.capability: AutoCAD Mechanical File IPC and .NET dispatcher boundary
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Contract tests plus AutoCAD Mechanical 2027 File IPC smoke when prerequisites exist; otherwise NOT RUN/SKIP.
capabilities.migration: Add multisource calls only through the existing File IPC request/result contracts.
capabilities.rollback: Revert new smoke/adapter references; existing File IPC remains unchanged.

capabilities.capability: Approved AutoCAD Mechanical repair operations
capabilities.adapter: Route approved repair plans through existing backup, live review, repair, and second-review gates.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Headless repair tests plus AutoCAD Mechanical live repair smoke with verified backup and human approval.
capabilities.migration: Keep production mutation behind existing mechanical-repair approvals and rollback checks.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the adapter and reopen the verified backup; no production drawing is mutated by R0.

capabilities.capability: Run manifests, PDF manifests, checkpoints, and resumability
capabilities.adapter: Bind source-bundle and candidate revision metadata to the existing manifest/checkpoint lifecycle without creating a second store.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Existing run/resume and run-pdf/resume-pdf contract tests plus hash-stable checkpoint evidence.
capabilities.migration: Extend current manifest fields only through cad_agent.manifest and preserve legacy readers/defaults.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the adapter fields; current manifests, checkpoints, and resume behavior remain authoritative.

capabilities.capability: Hash-bound Drawing Initialization Setup gate
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Drawing Setup contract and read-only AutoCAD Mechanical audit gates remain before geometry creation.
capabilities.migration: Use the existing Drawing Setup contracts and SETUP_VERIFIED evidence as the authoritative entry gate.
capabilities.rollback: Revert inventory references; Drawing Initialization behavior is unchanged.

capabilities.capability: Offline dimension-first pilot adapter and evidence
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Gate A setup evidence precedes Gate B dimension acceptance; Mechanical acceptance remains NOT RUN offline.
capabilities.migration: Keep dimension-first driving lengths and datum anchoring at the existing SolveSpace/DXF boundaries.
capabilities.rollback: Revert inventory references; existing Dimension Pilot remains unchanged.

capabilities.capability: Visual Supervisor T1 dimension observation
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Deterministic observer contract tests; private dimension benchmark when affected.
capabilities.migration: Reuse the existing observation/register evidence and do not add a second dimension recognizer.
capabilities.rollback: Revert inventory references; T1 observer remains unchanged.

capabilities.capability: Visual Supervisor T2 geometry comparator
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Comparator contract and deterministic trend tests; no visual verdict is inferred from comparator output alone.
capabilities.migration: Reuse comparator metrics as evidence input and keep verdict authority separate.
capabilities.rollback: Revert inventory references; T2 comparator remains unchanged.

capabilities.capability: Visual Supervisor T3 AutoCAD-native evidence exporter
capabilities.acceptance_gate: T3 contract tests and AutoCAD Mechanical live evidence export when prerequisites exist; otherwise NOT RUN/SKIP.
capabilities.migration: Keep AutoCAD-native evidence read-only and routed through the existing .NET File IPC operation.
capabilities.rollback: Revert inventory references; T3 evidence export remains unchanged.

capabilities.capability: Multisource source-bundle and evidence-role fusion
capabilities.acceptance_gate: A future source-bundle contract test and human review; no source fusion runtime is authorized by R0.
capabilities.migration: Introduce one orchestration boundary that references existing source, manifest, and evidence APIs without replacing them.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the future source-bundle boundary; existing image/PDF and evidence workflows remain intact.
capabilities.gap_reason: Existing manifests, PDF staging, and AutoCAD evidence export are separate boundaries; no complete source-bundle object fuses their roles and hashes into one multisource input record.

capabilities.capability: Exact-base CAD component extraction and provenance binding
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Future exact-base extraction contract, source hash, and human review before any candidate export.
capabilities.migration: Add a read-only extraction/provenance adapter over existing recognition and DXF boundaries.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the future extraction adapter; existing image/PDF recognition and DXF generation remain authoritative.
capabilities.gap_reason: The repository recognizes primitives and builds DXF, but has no complete read-only registry that extracts exact-base components from an approved CAD source and binds each component to source hashes and provenance.

capabilities.capability: Linked component and multi-view registry
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Future component/view registry contract and independent review of linked view identity.
capabilities.migration: Add one registry adapter over existing Semantic IR parts and DXF component handles.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the future registry; Semantic IR, DXF handles, and headless review remain unchanged.
capabilities.gap_reason: Existing Semantic IR parts and DXF handles are not a persistent component/view graph linking the same component across overall, detail, section, and AutoCAD-native views.

capabilities.capability: Candidate revision synchronization across artifacts and views
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Future revision manifest contract, immutable candidate test, and human promotion gate.
capabilities.migration: Build revision synchronization on the existing manifest, checkpoint, DXF, and visual-evidence hashes.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the future revision coordinator; existing manifests and checkpoints remain readable.
capabilities.gap_reason: Current manifests and checkpoints track individual pipeline stages, but no complete revision coordinator synchronizes multiple source/view candidates, supersession, and immutable artifact hashes.

capabilities.capability: Independent visual evidence verdict separate from generation
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Future independent verdict contract and delegated visual/human review; comparator output alone cannot be PASS.
capabilities.migration: Compose existing comparator, evidence, and AutoCAD review results without letting generation self-approve.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the future verdict coordinator; existing evidence and review records remain read-only.
capabilities.gap_reason: Existing geometry comparison and AutoCAD review produce separate evidence, but no independent verdict record aggregates them with explicit human/delegated approval without becoming a generation-side self-approval path.

capabilities.capability: Codex repair planning separated from repair execution
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Future hash-bound repair-plan contract, human approval, backup, and second-review gates.
capabilities.migration: Add a non-mutating planner that emits approved inputs for existing headless/mechanical repair APIs.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the planner; existing repair executors remain behind their current approval gates.
capabilities.gap_reason: Agent advice/application and repair executors exist, but no dedicated non-mutating Codex repair planner binds visual findings, repair scope, approvals, backups, and executor inputs into one auditable plan.

capabilities.capability: Verified candidate promotion with visual and Mechanical evidence
capabilities.adapter: Bind candidate promotion to existing visual contract authorization, evidence freshness, and read-only Mechanical review checkpoints.
capabilities.acceptance_gate: Delegated visual approval and AutoCAD Mechanical read-only review; production mutation remains separately gated.
capabilities.migration: Extend the current fidelity promotion flow without changing the ordinary production repair boundary.
capabilities.rollback: Revert the promotion adapter; existing review-only fidelity artifacts remain outside production mutation.
